requirements.title: Preserve learner meaning
requirements.statement: Corrections and generated learning units must preserve the learner's intended organisation and meaning unless an explicit higher-authority instruction requires a change.

requirements.title: Separate learning stages
requirements.statement: Night expression, morning retrieval, and long-term Anki review must remain distinct stages with distinct purposes.

requirements.title: Use meaningful context
requirements.statement: Context Cloze and Topic Retell targets must be embedded in complete meaningful context; isolated lexical testing is reserved for justified Vocabulary notes.

requirements.title: Allow uninterrupted free speaking
requirements.statement: During free speaking, the assistant must avoid unnecessary interruption and must not force the diary into predefined topics.

requirements.title: Lock immutable topic checkpoints
requirements.statement: Each completed substantive topic must have one versioned, stable, immutable Topic Reference Checkpoint; corrections create a new version rather than silently editing locked text.

requirements.title: Audit all substantive topics
requirements.statement: Night finalisation must map the complete conversation and must not finish until every substantive topic has exactly one current valid checkpoint and no substantive span remains unassigned.

requirements.title: Aggregate without rewriting
requirements.statement: The Night Reference Record must be assembled from current locked checkpoints in conversation order without changing checkpoint text or formatting except for permitted record metadata and separators.

requirements.title: Do not reveal morning answers
requirements.statement: The initial morning outline must contain retrieval cues without complete corrected sentences or answer text.

requirements.title: Use retrieval performance as evidence
requirements.statement: Forgotten, hesitant, inaccurate, or passively understood expressions should be treated as strong evidence during later learning-target selection.

requirements.title: Allow the learner to complete the retell
requirements.statement: The assistant must not interrupt the morning retell unless clarification is necessary and must allow the learner to complete the full reasoning before comparison begins.

requirements.title: Respect explicit learner markings
requirements.statement: Explicit learner formatting, manual Cloze edits, and direct instructions must take precedence over inferred learning value.

requirements.title: Use evidence-based predictive marking
requirements.statement: Predicted learning targets must be supported by observed production difficulty, direct wording questions, retrieval failure, or repeated approved preferences; sophistication alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Route predictions by confidence
requirements.statement: High-confidence predictions may enter the first review notebook, medium-confidence predictions require confirmation before export, and low-confidence predictions must be omitted until stronger evidence exists.

requirements.title: Separate content and card calibration
requirements.statement: Content-selection calibration and card-design calibration must be tracked separately, and card-design changes must not silently reopen approved content selection.

requirements.title: Apply source authority
requirements.statement: Every derived unit must resolve its authority according to the protocol order, and assistant-generated output must not validate itself or override an available authoritative source.

requirements.title: Preserve source semantics
requirements.statement: Generated notes must preserve actor, event, object, causal relation, chronology, polarity, certainty, qualification, stance, and material factual detail from the highest available authoritative source.

requirements.title: Build mark ledger before cards
requirements.statement: A complete atomic Manual Mark Ledger must be created and frozen before candidate card generation; a retrospective ledger cannot support a coverage pass.

verification.evidence: Ledger creation stage, stable IDs, and freeze record

requirements.title: Count only tested coverage
requirements.statement: A target counts as covered only when it occupies a protocol-approved tested position; visible context, prose, ledgers, explanations, and unapproved candidate lists do not count.

requirements.title: Use controlled coverage states
requirements.statement: Manual targets must use only the protocol-approved coverage states, and exclusion requires an explicit learner decision.

requirements.title: Block failed coverage builds
requirements.statement: A final or audit-passed artefact must not be produced unless the deterministic coverage equation holds and all uncovered, unresolved, boundary, incomplete-Guidance, and alignment error counts are zero.

requirements.title: Rescan the whole error class
requirements.statement: When one error is identified, the relevant previous audit becomes invalid and the complete artefact must be scanned again for the same error class before a revision can pass.

requirements.title: Preserve paired English identity
requirements.statement: Each Context Cloze and its paired Topic Retell must derive from one canonical English source and remain character-identical after mechanical removal of Cloze markup, subject only to explicitly permitted format differences.

requirements.title: Keep Cloze boundaries minimal
requirements.statement: A Cloze deletion must isolate the intended unfamiliar word or meaningful chunk without unnecessarily hiding familiar contextual scaffolding or expanding beyond the confirmed target.

requirements.title: Make Vocabulary independently retrievable
requirements.statement: Every Vocabulary front must independently bound one answer, one tightly bounded interchangeable set, or one explicit distinction without requiring another card.

requirements.title: Align Guidance bidirectionally
requirements.statement: Every Guidance blank must map to exactly one minimal English answer and exact highlight, and every highlight must map back to exactly one corresponding blank with equal count, order, meaning, and boundaries.

verification.evidence: Forward and reverse Guidance mapping report

requirements.title: Invalidate linked Guidance changes
requirements.statement: A change to any authoritative source, complete Guidance, answer, highlight, translation, blank range, or rendered underline must invalidate the prior Guidance pass and trigger all linked validations again.

requirements.title: Render Guidance blanks as underline only
requirements.statement: A Guidance front must remove the tested Chinese answer completely and display only a continuous underline at the original position without any answer-revealing residue.

verification.evidence: DOCX, exported field, and Anki render audit

requirements.title: Report independent audit states
requirements.statement: Content, manual-mark, card-design, and render audits must be reported independently, and the notebook is complete only when every required state passes.

requirements.title: Archive only learner-confirmed masters
requirements.statement: Only a learner-confirmed Final Review Notebook may become the canonical master used to generate Anki exports, and its storage location must be configured outside the repository.

verification.evidence: Confirmation record, canonical path policy, and source hash

requirements.title: Export only validated canonical data
requirements.statement: Canonical exports must be generated from the confirmed master using the required Note Type fields, encodings, tags, and content validations; temporary import copies must not replace canonical data.

verification.evidence: Export manifest and field-level validation report

requirements.title: Import into matching existing structures
requirements.statement: Each exported Note Type must be imported into its matching existing Note Type and subdeck without assigning notes directly to the parent deck or creating dated decks.

requirements.title: Reconcile collection state
requirements.statement: After import, the system must reconcile imported counts, Note Types, fields, tags, HTML, deck assignments, and parent-deck totals against the canonical export and a read-only collection state when available.

requirements.title: Complete post-cycle learning audit
requirements.statement: The workflow must not be declared complete until material corrections and failures have been classified, same-class scans recorded, and reusable protocol deltas distinguished from execution failures and one-off preferences.

requirements.title: Audit protocol changes conversation-wide
requirements.statement: A protocol release must account for every requested, approved, rejected, superseded, or materially ambiguous change across the complete relevant conversation and must preserve unrelated provisions.

verification.evidence: Conversation change ledger and paragraph-level release comparison

requirements.title: Minimise routine human review
requirements.statement: The system must resolve objective formatting, search, relationship, count, field, and established-rule questions automatically and must route only genuine material ambiguity and final acceptance to the learner.

requirements.title: Consolidate by meaning and retrieval purpose
requirements.statement: Candidate material must be compared across the complete notebook and consolidated when it expresses substantially the same meaning and retrieval purpose.

requirements.title: Distinguish synonyms from related expressions
requirements.statement: Slash alternatives may be combined only when they are interchangeable for the intended meaning and grammatical slot; non-interchangeable related expressions require an explicit distinction or separate retrieval task.

requirements.title: Prefer minimum coherent card expansion
requirements.statement: Newly approved targets must first be integrated into existing suitable learning units, and a new note is allowed only when it adds unique content or an independent retrieval ability that cannot be integrated without violating another rule.

verification.evidence: Card-count change audit and integration-failure reasons

requirements.title: Propagate confirmed targets by meaning
requirements.statement: Confirmed targets must be audited across the approved notebook and propagated only to observed occurrences with the same intended meaning or relevant word-family function, without manufacturing new English content.

requirements.title: Deliver an directly editable review notebook
requirements.statement: The review notebook must be directly editable and must not require the learner to copy, paste, or reconstruct proposed content in another interface.

requirements.title: Organise by coherent reasoning units
requirements.statement: Notebook content must be organised by broad topic and complete reasoning unit while preserving logical order and avoiding sentence-by-sentence card fragmentation.

requirements.title: Use stable semantic identity before display numbering
requirements.statement: Learning units must use stable semantic IDs throughout extraction and review, and sequential display card numbers must be assigned only after consolidation, splitting, and deletion are complete.

verification.evidence: Stable ID ledger and numbering-stage record

requirements.title: Apply the marked-content placement hierarchy
requirements.statement: Marked content must be placed by attempting natural existing Context integration, coherent extension, a new paired reasoning unit, justified Vocabulary, and Guidance in that order, subject to the distinct learning purpose rules.

requirements.title: Treat learner edits as authoritative
requirements.statement: Direct learner edits to the review notebook become the current authoritative version and must update affected ledgers and invalidate dependent audit results.

verification.evidence: Edited-source hash, change ledger, and invalidation record

requirements.title: Prevent reverse-cue leakage
requirements.statement: Visible synonyms, antonyms, translations, definitions, parallel structures, or predictable contrasts must not reveal a hidden answer without genuine retrieval.

requirements.title: Reserve full-sentence Cloze for confirmed sentence targets
requirements.statement: A whole sentence may be hidden only when the complete sentence is the confirmed target and contextual Cloze testing remains suitable; isolated sentence retrieval otherwise belongs in Vocabulary and does not create a Topic Retell pair.

verification.evidence: Whole-sentence target and Note Type suitability audit

requirements.title: Use complete Context translations
requirements.statement: A Context Cloze prompt must translate the complete canonical English content without omitting sentences, logical relationships, examples, or material detail.

requirements.title: Select Topic Retell by discourse value
requirements.statement: A dedicated Topic Retell must test a complete discourse or reasoning progression and must not be selected solely because of broad topic, paragraph length, sentence count, or one isolated lexical target.

requirements.title: Require one paired Topic Retell per Context Cloze
requirements.statement: Every Context Cloze must have exactly one corresponding paired Topic Retell unless that exact pair already exists; Guidance does not create a mandatory pair.

requirements.title: Render revealed answers consistently
requirements.statement: Every revealed Context Cloze answer and Guidance answer highlight must use the shared light-blue, bold, underlined answer style in supported display modes.

verification.evidence: Rendered day-mode and night-mode style audit

requirements.title: Use Cloze numbers according to intended card count
requirements.statement: Related deletions intended for one card must share a Cloze number, while distinct numbers may be used only when the design intentionally creates separate cards.

requirements.title: Keep Topic Retell cues concise and non-revealing
requirements.statement: A Topic Retell front must provide only a concise Chinese topic or logical cue and must not contain a complete translation or reveal the English wording.

verification.evidence: Topic Retell answer-leakage and cue-sufficiency audit

requirements.title: Use fixed broad deck destinations
requirements.statement: The four Note Types must map to their matching stable subdecks, while dated or narrowly topical decks and direct assignment to the parent deck are prohibited.

requirements.title: Keep Topic tags first-level and reusable
requirements.statement: Topic tags must contain exactly one approved broad primary category, may use the smallest accurate set of first-level categories, and must not create deeper or card-specific topic hierarchies.

verification.evidence: Tokenised Topic-tag depth and vocabulary audit

requirements.title: Admit Type tags only for independent learning value
requirements.statement: A Type tag may exist only when it identifies a stable, reusable, independently reviewable learning dimension not already represented by deck, Note Type, fields, date, Topic, or another Type.

requirements.title: Control Type creation and assignment
requirements.statement: Type categories must be created from actual qualifying cards, remain one level deep, normally contain at least two members, and be assigned from the tested objective rather than incidental words.

verification.evidence: Type creation, depth, membership, and set audit

requirements.title: Preserve approved unaffected content
requirements.statement: Final quality checks may correct actual language and technical errors but must not introduce unrequested stylistic upgrades, examples, alternatives, or memory targets, and unaffected content must remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Use canonical field contracts
requirements.statement: Each Note Type export must use its protocol-defined field count and order, with paragraph breaks represented as supported HTML and tags stored as non-displayed metadata.

requirements.title: Validate first live import behaviour
requirements.statement: The first live import must validate rendering, mappings, Cloze behaviour, tags, paired content, Guidance emphasis, deck totals, target consistency, and duplicate behaviour before settings are treated as established.

requirements.title: Keep private content outside the repository
requirements.statement: Real oral diaries, conversations, notebooks, Anki content, recordings, screenshots, and source-bearing logs must remain outside the public repository and its version history.

verification.evidence: Repository privacy scan and configured external data root
